title: hushrun.whoami/v1
description: Output of `hushrun whoami --format json` (spec C-17): where `hushrun run` records results, with which credential, and who the backend says that credential is. It exits 0 when the backend answered, 1 when it refused the credential and 6 when it couldn't be reached.

backend.description: The server's org URL, or null when results stay on this machine or are off.

signed_out.description: [ADR 0067] The backend the repository's package.json or hushrun.yaml names, which nothing here is signed in to: results stay in `directory` until someone signs in. Null otherwise, and left out by a hushrun from before it.

named_by.description: What named the server (C-11); with `signed_out`, the file that names it.

directory.description: Where results stay when no server is named: hushrun's cache directory.

off.description: Why results are off, when they are.

credential.description: What goes with the server's requests (C-13).

withheld.description: HUSHRUN_TOKEN is set, and this backend doesn't get it.

as.description: Who the server says the credential is: user:<email>, oidc:<subject> or agent:<name>.

token.description: For an agent token, the token as GET {base}/v0 describes it (C-12).

error.description: Why the server didn't say who the credential is.

machine.description: ADR 0028: this machine's key, which its sign-in registers and which signs its results, and where the key is; null when it has none yet.
